## Technical Summary

Vaibhav Bharathula is a software developer and machine learning engineer who designs scalable systems that combine data science pipelines, modern web applications, and low-latency architectures. His work spans predictive machine learning models, real-time collaboration engines, and multi-factor incident intelligence.

## Core Technical Skills

- Languages: Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL
- Frontend: Next.js 14, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, REST APIs

## Featured Projects

### CricSphere
- Description: High-performance cricket intelligence platform with live match data and AI-ML powered analytics.
- Technologies: React, Node.js, Express.js, RapidAPI, LightGBM, Python, DuckDB
- Scale: 22,000+ matches processed, 638K+ PvP matchup records analyzed, 4 ML prediction models.
- Live Demo: https://cricsphere-version1.vercel.app/
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/cricsphere

### Nexus
- Description: AI-native real-time collaboration operating system combining chat, multiplayer canvases, video calls, and zero-trust storage.
- Technologies: Next.js 14, Stream Video/Chat, Clerk Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Gemini, Pinecone, Liveblocks (Yjs CRDTs)
- Latency & Security: Sub-50ms WebRTC media, serverless short-TTL signed URLs (~1.1s revocation delay), vector semantic search.
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/nexus

### CampusPulse AI
- Description: Explainable real-time incident intelligence platform for IBM SkillsBuild project submission.
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, SQLite 3, Google Gemini 1.5 Flash
- Architecture: 4-factor deterministic correlation engine (spatial, temporal decay, semantic embeddings, categorical affinity) correlating student complaints into verified incidents.
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/campuspulse-ai

### AetherAI
- Description: Localized environmental intelligence and real-time air quality forecasting engine.
- Technologies: Python, FastAPI, XGBoost (94.2% confidence), Google Gemini API, SQLite
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/aetherai

### BrandRecognizer
- Description: Computer vision classifier trained via transfer learning with EfficientNetB0 on 11,000+ vehicle images across 50 brands (~80% test accuracy).
- Technologies: Python, TensorFlow, EfficientNetB0, Data Augmentation
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/brandrecognizer
